title: Hoodoo stories, Buddy Petit's spit trick and a bootlegger woman
summary: Miller describes belief in charms and tells of Buddy Petit winning a job with seeds and spitting, plus a woman bootlegger in Mobile, and the Cracker Jack drug store.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: He says, I know huh? How do you think it happened? Well, you know I tell you, they colored people got something the funnest idea you've ever seen. They can go over to a person over there and say give me something I'm gonna do something about it or something. You give them some money and they give you that and if you put it where they tell you it, they blow it up. Yeah. Yeah they do that. I know Buddy Petit. Buddy Petit, we all was walking around here and wasn't doing nothing but one band was playing Saturday and Friday and Sunday at the uh, right across from that store. I think what they called the name of that hall or no? Oh, Royal Garden. Royal Garden. He used to be on this side. And Buddy went and got something and said, we're gonna get that job. I said, yeah. He said, how you gonna do it? He said, I'm gonna use, you gonna chuck them tromping. I said, okay. And Buddy went and got something and talked with the man and kept a spitting, you know. He said, man, I said, what do you make spits on myself? I'm sick of the stomach. Kept a spitting. And that man gave Buddy the job. And Buddy told him, he said, he got some little seeds he put in his mouth. I don't know how to believe all that, Buddy's true. Put them little seeds in his mouth and talk to you and go to spit it. Sure, that's all. They believe in all that, you know what I mean, too? There's like a girl there from Yessie and Mobile right now. And I know a girl, she's got three houses there. She's running moonshine, John. And arrest everybody in that town. And what's the matter she got there? She sends you and get it, John. At the crack jacked trust. Because I went there for her. She had me to go there and tell the mail of the stuff she had. And her envelope closed up. And the man read it. And took her head and said he sent it. And she got bootleg junk and everything. And three houses and everything. If she don't ever get arrested, never get in trouble, never make plenty of money. She keep buying that stuff.
Three houses with the girls. Three houses, huh? Yeah. I mean, this is Beth Russ. Huh?

Got all these girls working for her over there? Yes, she got three houses. Running houses and everything. Oh. I thought you meant sporting houses. I got a lot of them. I got a lot of them. I don't know what I'm going to name. This is Beth Russ.
The cracker jacked. The cracker jacked seems to be the place, huh? That's where you go to get it. Yeah, the cracker jacked.
They're telling me, like that. Right down right. I'm supposed to be. I've been in there to buy some stuff for a coal.
One time, they looked at me funny. They couldn't understand anybody coming in and buying some medicine for a coal.
Yeah, they don't do much of that. They got all that kind of funny stuff. You know, like incense and all that kind of stuff.
